cell.label: PA suspected clinically. Order plasma aldosterone concentration/plasma renin activity ratio
Perform confirmatory test (saline suppression test, oral salt loading, fludrocortisone suppression test, or captopril suppression test).
Testing to confirm cause of PA: adrenal imaging with CT or MRI, and postural testing.

Consider other causes of resistant hypertension.
